This looks like a CBP ruling on a Halloween wreath. Festive articles fall under heading 9505, and the question is whether a wreath of this type belongs there or under 6702 as artificial flowers and foliage.

Heading 6702 covers artificial flowers and foliage, but Halloween decorations are generally treated as festive articles under 9505.10. The wreath's predominant features are the pumpkins and the snake, which are Halloween-themed, so 9505 fits better. Related CBP rulings have classified Halloween wreaths in 9505.90.6000, which covers other festive articles.

Subheading 9505.10 covers Christmas articles, so Halloween items fall under 9505.90. The statistical suffix 9505.90.6000 is "Other: Other."
